res-ai-road-1.title: Python for AI & Data Wrangling Video Masterclass
res-ai-road-1.description: Step 1 Video: NumPy arrays, matrix reshaping, Pandas dataframes, and data preprocessing for AI pipelines.
res-ai-road-1.summary: Master array vectorization and data manipulation for artificial intelligence models.

res-ai-road-2.title: Artificial Intelligence Core: Perceptrons & Backpropagation Math Video
res-ai-road-2.description: Step 2 Video: Mathematical breakdown of forward pass, loss functions, activation gradients, and backpropagation.
res-ai-road-2.summary: Understand gradient descent and weight optimization step-by-step.

res-ai-road-3.title: Deep Learning & Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) Video
res-ai-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: Convolutional filters, max pooling layers, feature maps, and image classification architectures.
res-ai-road-3.summary: Build and inspect spatial feature extractors in deep convolutional networks.

res-ai-road-4.title: Transformers & LLM Architectures Video (Attention Mechanism)
res-ai-road-4.description: Step 4 Video: Self-Attention mechanism, Scaled Dot-Product Attention, BERT, GPT, and modern Large Language Models.
res-ai-road-4.summary: Deep architectural walkthrough of Transformer encoders and decoders.

res-cs-road-1.title: Programming Fundamentals & Control Flow in Python Video
res-cs-road-1.description: Step 1 Video: Core programming logic, variables, conditional branch statements, loops, and function syntax.
res-cs-road-1.summary: Master foundational computer programming with interactive code execution.

res-cs-road-2.title: Data Structures, Big-O Complexity & Sorting Algorithms Video
res-cs-road-2.description: Comprehensive video lecture covering arrays (static and dynamic), linked lists (singly and doubly), stacks, queues, priority queues, binary search trees, graph representations & traversals (BFS, DFS), Big-O asymptotic notation, and common sorting algorithms (Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and QuickSort).
res-cs-road-2.summary: Master data structures (arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs), Big-O complexity analysis, and essential sorting algorithms (Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, Quick).

res-cs-road-3.title: Full Stack Web Architecture & REST API Engineering Video
res-cs-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: HTTP client-server architecture, RESTful API endpoint design, JSON serialization, and database queries.
res-cs-road-3.summary: Design scalable backends and modern web frontends.

res-cs-road-4.title: System Design, DevOps & Distributed Microservices Video
res-cs-road-4.description: Step 4 Video: Distributed system architecture, load balancing, horizontal scaling, caching strategies, and Docker containers.
res-cs-road-4.summary: Architect high-concurrency systems handling millions of daily requests.

res-math-road-1.title: Discrete Mathematics, Logic Gates & Set Theory Video
res-math-road-1.description: Step 1 Video: Propositional logic truth tables, boolean algebra, set theory operations, and mathematical proofs.
res-math-road-1.summary: Build mathematical rigorous thinking for computer algorithms.

res-math-road-2.title: Differential & Integral Calculus Visually Explained Video
res-math-road-2.description: Step 2 Video: Limits, rates of change, power rule derivatives, anti-derivatives, and definite integrals.
res-math-road-2.summary: Intuitive geometric understanding of continuous rates of change.

res-math-road-3.title: Linear Algebra Essence: Vectors, Matrices & Transformations Video
res-math-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: Vector spaces, linear transformations, matrix multiplication, determinants, and eigenvalues.
res-math-road-3.summary: Visual linear algebra foundation essential for machine learning geometry.

res-math-road-4.title: Probability Distributions & Bayesian Decision Statistics Video
res-math-road-4.description: Step 4 Video: Random variables, Gaussian normal distributions, conditional probability, and Bayes Theorem inference.
res-math-road-4.summary: Master statistical inference and probabilistic modeling.

res-phys-road-1.title: Classical Mechanics: Kinematics & Newton Laws Video
res-phys-road-1.description: Step 1 Video: Displacement, velocity, constant acceleration equations, forces, and Newton three motion laws.
res-phys-road-1.summary: Explore mechanical motion with live physical trajectory simulations.

res-phys-road-2.title: Electromagnetism, Circuit Laws & Maxwell Equations Video
res-phys-road-2.description: Step 2 Video: Coulomb electric force, magnetic fields, Ohm Law, circuit currents, and Maxwell field equations.
res-phys-road-2.summary: Master electrical potential and magnetic field propagation.

res-phys-road-3.title: Quantum Mechanics, Wave Function & Double Slit Video
res-phys-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: Wave-particle duality, double-slit interference, Planck energy quantization, and Schrödinger wave equation.
res-phys-road-3.summary: Deep dive into quantum mechanical wave packet collapse.

res-bio-road-1.title: Cellular Biology, Organelles & ATP Energy Video
res-bio-road-1.description: Step 1 Video: Eukaryotic cell membrane structure, mitochondria ATP synthesis, nucleus, and ribosomes.
res-bio-road-1.summary: 3D animation tour through microscopic cellular organelles.

res-bio-road-2.title: DNA Replication, Transcription & Translation Video
res-bio-road-2.description: Step 2 Video: Double-helix unzipping by helicase, RNA polymerase transcription, mRNA processing, and ribosome translation.
res-bio-road-2.summary: Step-by-step molecular biology of central dogma.

res-bio-road-3.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing & Genomic Biotech Video
res-bio-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: Targeted genomic cuts using Cas9 endonuclease, single guide RNA (sgRNA) design, and therapeutic gene therapy.
res-bio-road-3.summary: Discover revolutionary gene editing technologies in modern biotechnology.

res-chem-road-1.title: Atomic Models, Electron Shells & Periodic Trends Video
res-chem-road-1.description: Comprehensive video lecture covering atomic models (Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr, Quantum mechanical model), electron shells and orbital energy levels (s, p, d, f), electron configuration rules (Aufbau, Pauli, Hund), and periodic trends including atomic radius, ionization energy, electron affinity, and electronegativity.
res-chem-road-1.summary: Explore atomic models, electron shells, electron configuration, and periodic trends with high-quality educational demonstrations.

res-chem-road-2.title: Organic Functional Groups & Reaction Mechanisms Video
res-chem-road-2.description: Step 2 Video: Alcohols, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, SN1 vs SN2 nucleophilic substitution, and arrow-pushing mechanisms.
res-chem-road-2.summary: Master organic chemistry synthesis and reaction steps.

res-chem-road-3.title: Chemical Thermodynamics, Enthalpy & Reaction Kinetics Video
res-chem-road-3.description: Step 3 Video: Reaction rate laws, activation energy, Arrhenius equation, Hess Law, and Gibbs Free Energy spontaneity.
res-chem-road-3.summary: Analyze chemical thermodynamics and reaction rate equations.

assign-ai-mcq-1.title: AI & Machine Learning Foundations Assignment
assign-ai-mcq-1.description: Assess foundational understanding of Artificial Intelligence concepts, neural network mechanics, and supervised learning.

questions.text: Which type of learning uses labeled input and output training pairs?
What is the role of backpropagation in deep neural networks?

assign-cs-mcq-1.title: Data Structures & Algorithms Practical Assignment
assign-cs-mcq-1.description: Practical assessment on time complexity, recursion, trees, and hash map operations.

questions.text: What is the average time complexity for lookup in a hash map?
Which data structure follows First-In, First-Out (FIFO) order?

assign-math-mcq-1.title: Calculus & Matrix Operations Assignment
assign-math-mcq-1.description: Test your understanding of derivatives, integrals, and linear algebraic transformations.

questions.text: What is the derivative of sin(x) with respect to x?
What is the determinant of a 2x2 identity matrix?

assign-physics-mcq-1.title: Mechanics & Electromagnetism Assignment
assign-physics-mcq-1.description: Solve fundamental problems in kinematics, Newtonian dynamics, and electromagnetic induction.

questions.text: What is Newton second law of motion?
What SI unit is used to measure magnetic flux density?

assign-bio-mcq-1.title: Cellular Biology & Genetics Assignment
assign-bio-mcq-1.description: Verify your knowledge of cellular respiration, DNA replication, and Mendelian inheritance.

questions.text: Which organelle is considered the powerhouse of the cell?
Which nitrogenous base pairs with Adenine in DNA?

assign-chem-mcq-1.title: Molecular Chemistry & Reaction Kinetics Assignment
assign-chem-mcq-1.description: Explore chemical equilibrium, organic reaction mechanisms, and thermodynamic spontaneity.

questions.text: What is the pH of a neutral aqueous solution at 25 degrees Celsius?
Which gas law relates pressure and volume at constant temperature?
